tools.name: search_inventory
tools.description:
Search the current grocery inventory.

Use this tool when the user asks whether a specific food item is available,
wants to find items in a category, or wants to check items stored in a
particular location.

This is a read-only tool. It does not add, update, remove, or consume
inventory items.

Returns matching inventory rows from user_inventory.csv.

query.description: Optional text search across inventory item name, brand, and notes. Use this for searches like "chicken", "oats", "pasta", or "use soon". Leave blank when filtering only by category or location.
query.title: Query

category.description: Optional inventory category filter. Use broad categories such as "pantry", "protein", "dairy", "vegetable", "fruit", or "snack". Leave blank if category is not needed.
category.title: Category

location.description: Optional storage location filter. Use locations such as "cupboard", "fridge", "freezer", or "pantry". Leave blank if location is not needed.
location.title: Location

tools.name: add_inventory_item
tools.description:
Add one new grocery inventory item.

Use this when the user wants to record a new grocery item that is not
already represented in the inventory.

This tool creates a new inventory row and the service layer generates
the stock_id internally.

Do not use this tool to update an existing item, reduce servings, mark
an item as consumed, or correct an existing inventory row.

food_item.description: Name of the food item to add. Required. Example: "Rolled oats".
food_item.title: Food Item

brand.description: Brand name if known. Leave blank if unknown. Example: "Uncle Tobys".
brand.title: Brand

quantity.description: Numeric amount of the item. Use with unit. Example: 1 for one bag, 500 for 500 g.
quantity.title: Quantity

servings_remaining.description: Estimated number of usable servings remaining. Example: 10.
servings_remaining.title: Servings Remaining

expiry_date.description: Expiry or use-by date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Leave blank if unknown.
expiry_date.title: Expiry Date

notes.description: Optional notes about the item. Example: "Use soon" or "Added during grocery shop".
notes.title: Notes

tools.name: get_recent_intake
tools.description:
Get recent food intake records from the user's intake history.

Args:
    days_back: Number of days back from today to include.
    meal_type: Optional filter such as breakfast, lunch, dinner, or snack.

Returns:
    A list of recent intake history records, newest first.

tools.name: get_daily_intake_summary
tools.description:
Get all logged meals, food items, and calculated nutrition totals
for a specific date.

Args:
    date: Date to summarise in YYYY-MM-DD format.

Returns:
    A dictionary containing:
    - date
    - meal_count
    - item_count
    - meals
    - items
    - nutrition_totals
    - missing_nutrition_counts
